text:
zara-marketing: Need a compact creative bundle for the "Inference Teardown" webinar next Wed. Must ship first drafts in 48h. Deliverables: 3 social assets (1:1, 16:9 hero, 9:16 story), a single-page benchmark PNG + .fig, a 3-panel explainer slide (latency vs cost vs throughput), and an inbound routing microdiagram (CTA -> LP -> 3-email nurture -> SDR).
zara-marketing: Constraints: mobile-first, full logo lockup on hero, stacked lockup on small, AA contrast, tiny legal footer: 'Illustrative metrics; results vary.'
diego-design: On it. Two directions I'll explore: "Teardown Data" (charts + callouts) and "System Flow" (icons + paths). Any hard numbers to include?
zara-marketing: Include one indicative number example on the benchmark card (label as illustrative). No percent claims without legal sign-off.
lina-motion: I can produce motion-friendly frames and a 5s story loop. Will export PNG keyframes + MP4 and Lottie fallback. Tagging Diego to sync layer names.
colin-growth: For routing microdiagram: suggested UTM `?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_teardown_v1`. CTA options: "Watch demo & claim credits" / "See predictable inference". I'll drop 2 subject lines for nurture into the doc.
diego-design: Quick color token test:
```
--rdw-primary-700: #0b3d91
--rdw-primary-500: #3461d3
--rdw-accent-300: #ffb547
--rdw-text-900: #0b0b0b
```
I'll produce an alternate high-contrast pair.
ux-bot: EXPORT CHECKLIST (automated): include Figma link, artboards 1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920, 1920x1080; exports: PNG 1x/2x, MP4 (story), layered .fig, color tokens, font files, AA contrast notes. Ensure logo lockups and legal footer on benchmark.
diego-design: Pushing two starter comps into Figma in ~24hrs. Prioritizing benchmark PNG and routing diagram. Lina, I'll prefix export layers with "exp_".
lina-motion: Got the prefix. Will deliver keyframes in 36h.
zara-marketing: Great — review sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
